title: ENS-eip4824
tagline: EIP-4824 Introduces DAO URI to organize DAO Metadata, This project paves an ENS pathway to adopt EIP-4824
description: This project helps adopt EIP-4824 for DAOs, many DAOs own an ENS domain but all it points to is DAOs hosted domain or a contract address, with EIP-4824, a DAO publishes their meta data in a JSON format helping standardize DAO Metadata, which helps improve DAO toolings, DAO frameworks, DAO Aggregators etc
how_its_made:
This project is ENS focused, it uses ENS Thorin design system for UI/UX, RainbowKit for wallet connections, Fleek IPFS and Hosting to host the project, and ENSjs and ENS GraphQL to set daouri record and fetch the details of DAOs that have adopted EIP-4824.
I am using NextJS and Typescript for this project
